name: Spare Parts
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Hiram “0mission” Svensson, Vantage Point's Shaper identity (Stage 5d), on a rig of hardware to install and trash — Methuselah trashes hardware from the grip as a run begins, and Pantograph beside it is a second console the rules trash. In-faction only. Stage 7b: two Read-Write Share for two Creative Commission. Stage 3a: two “Pretty” Mary da Silva, which The Maker's Eye and Jailbreak give a second R&D access to add to, and two Meeting of Minds for the connections, on six influence — for a Vrcation, a Telework Contract, a Diesel and an Overclock. Stage 3b: two Cupellation, which Jailbreak's HQ runs give a card to host and a second breach to spend it on, on four more influence — for a Beta Build and a Sure Gamble. Stage 3c: two Trick Shot, an Alarm Clock and a Window of Opportunity, on thirteen influence of fifteen — for a Meeting of Minds, a Touchstone, a T400 Memory Diamond and a Diesel. Stage 3d: two Muse and a Stowaway for Muse to find and put on ice, in-faction — for a DZMZ Optimizer, a Principia and a Mayfly. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 6c: two Cataloguer for a T400 Memory Diamond and a Sure Gamble. The Automata Initiative Stage 2: two LilyPAD for DZMZ Optimizer and T400 Memory Diamond, a console for the memory. The Automata Initiative Stage 4: two Slap Vandal for a Gordian Blade and an Echelon — Safety Net's one Gordian Blade went unseen in a 256-seed sweep with this deck's gone — and two Pichação for two Jailbreak.
